thought.text: sed choked on the `|` in the token (it's sed's delimiter). Let me write the env file directly:

reasoning_content: The reason sed failed is that the token contains `|`, which is the delimiter of sed. Instead, I'll either use a different delimiter, or just write the file with printf.

action.command: cd /workspace && docker exec -u root vereinfacht-tooling-1 bash -c 'cd /var/www/html/web_application && { cat .env.local.example | sed "s#^API_BEARER_TOKEN=.*#API_BEARER_TOKEN=1|BTSJGaZ2zLITV0ZTpEdSNiterXyhlma7hH8TYtLXaec176d2#"; } > .env.local && cat .env.local && chown verein:verein .env.local'
